title: The Missing Parish
author: W. M. Reyes
blurb: Felix Reyes, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
